set.body:
Follow-up from 75fd2a3 / bd-01M17B5EQ0R3KAA79CSN1AT18Y. Absorb is landed; NormTolerance stayed 1e-6 as scoped.

THE CLAIM. Accumulated error after an L2 divide is ~1e-16. NormTolerance = 1e-6 is about nine orders wider, so of(L2) is not absorbing float noise. It is a door for vectors that were never normalized.

CALLER SWEEP on main 75fd2a3, grep ValidatedVector.of(..., L2) and Normalization.L2 across */src/main and tests.

Production of(L2) call sites: exactly two, both in embed-core/vector.scala.
- l2() divides by n, then calls of.
- truncated() divides the head by n, then calls of.
After an explicit /n, residual is ulp-scale. Neither site needs 1e-6.

Other Normalization.L2 mentions in main are EmbeddingSpace / geometry labels (identity.scala, baselines.scala, embed-grakern/distance.scala), not ValidatedVector.of.

Test-only of(L2) near-misses live in VectorSuite (5e-7 and the ±NormTolerance pins we just added). Gens.unit goes through l2().

OCCURS: no production caller on this tree passes a raw near-unit vector to of(L2). The wide door is permitted and unused in-repo. External/unpublished callers are unmeasured.

PROPOSED WORK. Measure any remaining of(L2) callers after this sweep (including unpublished adapters). If still only the two normalizers, tighten NormTolerance to something that still admits post-divide residue (e.g. 1e-12 or ulp-relative) and pin both sides again. Do not couple that change to any other absorb/identity work.

I am not claiming this. Assign if you want it.
set.title: embed-core: NormTolerance 1e-6 admits never-normalized L2 vectors; production of(L2) callers are only the two normalizers
